mapper.sql: n.node_id, n.node_type, n.node_nm, n.node_desc, n.site_cd, n.location_nm, n.parent_node_id, n.sort_ord
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_net_node n ORDER BY n.sort_ord, n.node_id
mapper.sql: SELECT s.server_id, s.system_nm, s.fqdn, s.os_type, s.ip_addr, s.switch_node_id, s.status_cd, s.sync_status, s.pair_server_id, s.sort_ord, n.location_nm, m.cpu_pct, m.mem_pct, m.disk_pct, m.session_cnt FROM tb_server s INNER JOIN tb_net_node n ON n.node_id = s.switch_node_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_server_metric m ON m.server_id = s.server_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_server ( system_nm, fqdn, os_type, ip_addr, switch_node_id, status_cd, sync_status, pair_server_id, sort_ord, reg_dt, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{systemNm}, #{fqdn}, #{osType}, #{ipAddr}, #{switchNodeId}, #{statusCd}, #{syncStatus}, #{pairServerId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sortOrd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_server SET system_nm = #{systemNm}, fqdn = #{fqdn}, os_type = #{osType}, ip_addr = #{ipAddr}, switch_node_id = #{switchNodeId}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, sync_status = #{syncStatus}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_server SET pair_server_id = NULL, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pair_server_id = #{serverId}

UPDATE tb_server_metric SET cpu_pct = #{cpuPct}, mem_pct = #{memPct}, disk_pct = #{diskPct, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, session_cnt = #{sessionCnt}, collect_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.sql: p.proc_id, p.server_id, p.proc_nm, p.exec_path, p.pid, p.cpu_pct, p.mem_pct, p.running_yn, p.sort_ord
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_server_process p ORDER BY p.server_id, p.sort_ord, p.proc_id
SELECT FROM tb_server_process p WHERE p.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY p.sort_ord, p.proc_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_server_process SET proc_nm = #{procNm}, exec_path = #{execPath}, pid = #{pid, jdbcType=INTEGER}, cpu_pct = #{cpuPct}, mem_pct = #{memPct}, running_yn = #{runningYn}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND proc_id = #{procId}
UPDATE tb_server_process SET pid = NULL, cpu_pct = 0, mem_pct = 0, running_yn = 'N', upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}

UPDATE tb_server_process SET pid = #{pid, jdbcType=INTEGER}, cpu_pct = #{cpuPct}, mem_pct = #{memPct}, running_yn = #{runningYn}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND proc_id = #{procId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_server_metric_hist (server_id, collect_dt, cpu_pct, mem_pct, disk_pct, session_cnt, src_cd) VALUES (#{serverId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{cpuPct, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{memPct, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{diskPct, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{sessionCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{srcCd})

INSERT INTO tb_process_metric_hist (proc_id, server_id, collect_dt, cpu_pct, mem_pct, running_yn, src_cd) VALUES (#{procId}, #{serverId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{cpuPct}, #{memPct}, #{runningYn}, #{srcCd})

choose.when: SELECT h.server_id, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.disk_pct, h.session_cnt, h.src_cd FROM tb_server_metric_hist h WHERE h.collect_dt >= dateadd(hh, -24, getdate()) ORDER BY h.server_id, h.collect_dt, h.hist_id
choose.otherwise: SELECT t.server_id, t.collect_dt, t.cpu_pct, t.mem_pct, t.disk_pct, t.session_cnt, t.src_cd FROM (SELECT h.server_id, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.disk_pct, h.session_cnt, h.src_cd, h.hist_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.server_id ORDER BY h.collect_dt DESC, h.hist_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_server_metric_hist h) t WHERE t.rn <= #{points} ORDER BY t.server_id, t.collect_dt, t.hist_id

choose.when: SELECT h.proc_id, h.server_id, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.running_yn, h.src_cd FROM tb_process_metric_hist h WHERE h.collect_dt >= dateadd(hh, -24, getdate()) ORDER BY h.proc_id, h.collect_dt, h.hist_id
choose.otherwise: SELECT t.proc_id, t.server_id, t.collect_dt, t.cpu_pct, t.mem_pct, t.running_yn, t.src_cd FROM (SELECT h.proc_id, h.server_id, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.running_yn, h.src_cd, h.hist_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.proc_id ORDER BY h.collect_dt DESC, h.hist_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_process_metric_hist h) t WHERE t.rn <= #{points} ORDER BY t.proc_id, t.collect_dt, t.hist_id
